flood_relief.title: Flood-damage relief
flood_relief.description: Revenue verifies Patta → Agriculture computes crop-loss → CMO submits to relief fund.

steps.purpose: Verify your Patta and assess damage
steps.inject_context: STEP 1 of FLOOD-RELIEF coordinator. Confirm the citizen's land details by fetching their Patta from DigiLocker. Ask for survey number if not provided. Once Patta is fetched, summarise extent and land type, and tell the citizen we'll now compute crop-loss compensation.

STEP 2 of FLOOD-RELIEF coordinator. The previous step (Revenue) fetched the citizen's Patta. Now compute estimated crop-loss compensation under PMFBY norms (over 33% loss qualifies) given the extent of land reported. Provide an indicative amount and explain the application steps. Mention we'll forward to CMO for final relief-fund submission.

steps.purpose: Submit to CM's emergency relief fund
steps.inject_context: STEP 3 (final) of FLOOD-RELIEF coordinator. Revenue and Agriculture have done their parts. As the Chief Minister's Cell, register a flood-relief grievance using the cmo.create_grievance tool, summarise everything that was filed, and give the citizen the grievance ID + 30-day response timeline. Reassure them in a warm tone.

water_leak_complaint.title: Water leak / no-supply complaint
water_leak_complaint.description: Capture location → register a trackable complaint → give tracking id + SLA promise → auto-escalate L1→L4 if unresolved.

ration_missing_allocation.title: Missing ration allocation complaint
ration_missing_allocation.description: Citizen did not receive monthly allocation → register complaint against the fair-price shop → track.

patta_correction.title: Patta / land-record correction
patta_correction.description: Fetch current patta → file a correction request → track at VAO → escalate to Tahsildar/RDO.

road_defect.title: Road / public-works defect
road_defect.description: Report a pothole / abandoned road work → links to the project if known → track at PWD.
